analysis.title: Dark Immersive Travel Explorer
analysis.notes: A dark travel landing page uses dramatic mountain, forest, lake, and waterfall photography with cyan accents to create a cinematic sense of exploration. Large left-aligned headings, compact utility navigation, tour cards, and layered video thumbnails establish a structured but editorial composition.
analysis.heroPrompt: Cinematic wide-angle landscape photograph of a turquoise alpine lake surrounded by rugged misty mountains and dark evergreen forest, viewed from behind a lone seated traveler on a rocky overlook. Moody overcast light, deep charcoal shadows, subtle atmospheric haze, rich natural textures, subdued earthy greens and slate blues, with a clear open area on the left for large headline text. Premium travel editorial art direction, dramatic but serene, no logos, no readable text.
